one_line: Statistician and planner who built India’s survey and planning framework from Calcutta to New Delhi.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s to early-50s, lean build, upright posture befitting a disciplined academic official.
appearance.face: Oval face with high forehead, medium-brown Bengali complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed thin moustache, sharp attentive eyes behind round spectacles, default expression calm and analytical with a slight, knowing half-smile.
appearance.hair: Short, neatly combed black hair with a subtle side part, lightly flecked with grey at the temples; no headwear, hair kept close to the scalp with a disciplined, professor-like look.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate 1940s–1960s formal attire: a well-fitted light-cream khadi Nehru jacket (band collar, four front buttons, two lower pockets) over a crisp white long-sleeved cotton shirt, paired with straight-cut medium-grey wool trousers and plain black leather oxford shoes; he sometimes adds a simple dark-navy woolen shawl draped neatly over one shoulder in colder Delhi scenes, but the default model sheet shows him without the shawl; a slim steel wristwatch on his left hand and simple round metal-framed spectacles complete the bureaucrat-academic look.
appearance.signature: A rolled-up large survey map tied with a thin brown string in his left hand, and a dark-brown leather clipboard under his right arm holding visible sheets of statistical tables and hand-drawn charts.

ref_desc: Mid-40s Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis has an oval medium-brown face with round spectacles, short black hair, cream khadi Nehru jacket over white shirt, grey trousers, black shoes, and carries a rolled survey map plus brown clipboard in a cream-grey-black-navy palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis: a lean, mid-40s Indian man with an oval medium-brown face, high forehead, thin moustache, and sharp eyes behind round metal-framed spectacles, wearing short neatly combed black hair with a side part. He stands upright in a light-cream khadi Nehru jacket with band collar, four buttons, and two lower pockets over a crisp white long-sleeved cotton shirt, paired with straight-cut medium-grey wool trousers and plain black leather oxford shoes, with a slim steel wristwatch on his left wrist. In his left hand he holds a rolled-up large survey map tied with brown string, and under his right arm he tucks a dark-brown leather clipboard stacked with papers showing statistical tables and charts. Use a cream, white, medium grey, black, dark navy, and warm brown palette, and show front, side, and back views to capture his exact face, hair, garments, and signature props consistently.
